readerCopy.summary: The humanitarian narrative faces the workers and communities documenting what the campaign left out.
readerCopy.body: The humanitarian narrative faces the workers and communities documenting what the campaign left out. One side points to awareness, donations, and a public moved to care; the other points to private contracts, controlled access, and cleanup assigned to people with no authority. Neptune holds the moral story, while Pluto reveals the power and material interests operating behind it. The opposition places genuine compassion directly across from the machinery using that compassion as cover. The cause may remain worthy while the institution speaking for it loses the right to control the story.
